CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.
   C. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use John the Baptist to the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing John the Baptist to the Messiah.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Prophecies about the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophecies about the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophecies about the Messiah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Prophecies about the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.
   B. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.
   D. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

7. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.
   D. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.
   B. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Accounts of Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.
   C. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

12. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.
   D. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Accounts of Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Stewardship over Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Responsibility over Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Use of Natural Resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
